name: SD-ONLINE-the-weights-flat
note: Half the Bay's dungeons are medium (Mac: medium the default online); flat weights make it a third.

name: SD-ONLINE-unsalted
note: Without its own salt a dungeon's size is any other draw the port makes on its map id.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-last-size-never-drawn
old:
if (u < w) return size;
    u -= w;
new:
if (u < w) return size === 'full' ? 'medium' : size;
    u -= w;
note: Large is one of the world's three sizes - every one of them is drawn.

name: SD-ONLINE-a-quest-stamped-online-ignored
old: if (quest && quest.smallerDungeonsState === ONLINE_DUNGEONS_STATE) return onlineDungeonSize(dfLocation);   // SD-ONLINE: the world's, as its markers know it
note: A quest started online, taken offline, would build its dungeons at the settings' size, not the size its markers know.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-world-ask-ignored
old: if (world) return onlineDungeonSize(dfLocation);   // SD-ONLINE: offline, the world's sizes asked for
note: The world-dungeon-sizes row (the sync's copy of the online law) would do nothing offline.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-stamp-ignores-the-ask
note: A quest started offline at the world's sizes would be stamped medium (or whole) and build a layout its markers were not chosen on.

name: SD-ONLINE-adopt-blind-to-the-world
old: const portSize = (state) => state === MEDIUM_DUNGEONS_STATE || state === ONLINE_DUNGEONS_STATE;
note: E5 with the world's sizes either side: the quest must take the link's size, the one its markers were chosen on.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-build-says-whole
note: A medium build named whole would stand in the whole dungeon's room, beside pages that lay it whole.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-small-room-shared
old: export const DUNGEON_ROOM_TAGS = Object.freeze({ medium: '.m', small: '.s' });
new: export const DUNGEON_ROOM_TAGS = Object.freeze({ medium: '.m', small: '' });
note: A small build would share the whole dungeon's room, its streams and its memory by index.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-small-room-refused
note: A small dungeon's room would keep no world: no host, no memory, every player stepping their own foes.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-room-blind
note: Every size of a dungeon in one room - AUDIT WORLD34 B2's two layouts trading frames by index.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-identity-blind
note: The mode machine's identity must carry the built size, or the world host names every dungeon's room whole.

name: SD-ONLINE-the-world-row-left-to-the-player
note: Online the world's sizes are the room's law: forced on, the row says so and the sync copies it home.
